name: Popup
description: An anchored floating surface for arbitrary content: the menu component's MenuPopup (re-exported) plus showShadcnPopup, a generic helper with Escape/outside-tap dismissal.

theme.note: The surface tokens are menu-owned; showShadcnPopup accepts a MenuPopupTheme as its widget-leg override.

accessibility.keyboard: Escape closes the popup (the helper binds DismissIntent); with modal: true focus is trapped on the surface while it is open
accessibility.semantics: the surface is a plain decorated box: give the content its own semantics

sizes.surface: MenuPopup defaults: min-width 192 (12rem), padding 4, 1px border, radius md

notes: MenuPopup/MenuPopupTheme are re-exported from menu (B13) and never re-declared.
The old popup depended on dialog for DialogOverlayHandler padding sniffing; that sniffing is deleted in menu, so the dependency dissolved.
The old MenuPopup surfaceOpacity/surfaceBlur/fillColor/borderColor fields are replaced by MenuPopupTheme's token fields (B13).
showShadcnPopup is new: the old component was only the surface, with no helper to present it.
